title: eugenia macrocalyx
intro: Eugenia macrocalyx, commonly known as Brazilian guava, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae, native to Brazil. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia macrocalyx include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia macrocalyx include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
